> **For Copilot / AI reviewers:** Please follow the [debugging workflow in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`](../copilot-instructions.md#debugging-workflow):
> 1. Read the code carefully.
> 2. Pinpoint exactly where it breaks and why.
> 3. Explain the root cause in plain language.
> 4. Show the corrected version of the code.
> 5. Explain what changed and why it fixes the issue.
